entityFieldPolicy: All seven complete canonical records and15 RELATED_SEARCH aliases reviewed; no crosswalk entries. rdsReview: No local RDS or incident RDS endpoint. DomainKnowledge remains multidimensional Driver; PSY-078 belongs F09. Internal concept maps are not network RDS or scientific Relationships; no direct RDS target.

layersConsidered.BIO: Acute stress and memory encoding/consolidation/retrieval timing reviewed; physiological manipulation not subjective appraisal or clinical advice.
layersConsidered.PSY: Causal judgments, internal models, retrieval practice, familiarity and confidence considered with cue/current-state distinctions.
layersConsidered.SOC: Confederate misinformation and confirming feedback; social information can contaminate recollection, not establish accuracy.
layersConsidered.CUL: Cultural memory-specificity comparison includes response-bias/recognition alternatives; no exact causal CUL construct.
layersConsidered.ENV: Environmental reinstatement and cue competition; physical boundary change is not latent memory change.
layersConsidered.INS: Educational testing/lineup protocols and stakes considered; operation is not policy effectiveness or permission.
layersConsidered.INF: Studied text, repetition, outcome frequencies, misinformation and feedback content; exposure versus uptake and veracity versus confidence separated.
layersConsidered.TEC: Digital storage/access expectations versus content/location memory; no broad enduring technology-loss claim.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Free-recall practice and confirming-feedback operations considered; identities separated from effects/ethics.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Everyday retrieval, collaborative recall and use of external storage; uncontrolled activity not randomized causal knowledge.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Acute stressor/episode and later recall considered; occurrence alone does not establish consequence.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Encoding/retrieval surroundings and reinstatement literature; no universal context effect.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Testing policies and identification procedures considered without inferring policy efficacy from lab operations.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Storage availability, reminders and computer primes; different manipulations/replications not interchangeable.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Confederate misinformation and confirmation; interpersonal communication not a network-state EffectAssertion.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Prose study/retrieval cues, outcome contingencies, repetition and feedback examined.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Stress timing/cortisol and episodic outcomes; no physiological mediator inferred from meta-analysis.
